name: St Mary, Levenshulme
note: Now part of a new parish of St Robert of Newminster (22.09.2017)

boundary.description: From the junction of Birchfields Road and Old Hall Lane, E along Old Hall Lane, Park Grove, Stockport Road, Barlow Road, Manor Road, Sandford Lane, Nelstrop Lane North and then by a beeline between Wilsthorpe Grove (St Mary’s parish) and Simon Freeman Close (St Joseph’s, Reddish parish) to and along Norfolk Avenue, Wellington Road North, Crossley Road, Grangethorpe Drive, N along Kingsway, Mossley Road and Birchfields Road to its junction with Old Hall Lane.
